Second slug (/rubber-king-tyres-india-pvt-ltd) shows US-side records: "2022-12-27 RUBBER KING TYRES INDIA PVT. LTD. TO THE ORDER GEMINI" BRAND BUTYL INNER TUBES.( Mundra, India Istanbul, Turkey 870028 AEV300800100". Source counter: page header states "Total Shipments 3126 Records detected", "Trading Partners 9", "Ports 28", "Latest Cargo 2026-02-28"; rows actually visible in free view: 5 dated shipment rows (2026-02-23 to 2026-02-28) on the India-customs page plus 5 dated rows (2022-05-24 to 2022-12-27) on the alternate slug page = 10 rows seen vs 3126 claimed.
domestic_evidence: No public GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or annual-report domestic split could be retrieved: zaubacorp.com and thecompanycheck.com returned HTTP 403, tofler.in returned HTTP 404 for the guessed CIN, and the web_search backend returned "no results (searx: <urlopen error [Errno 111] Connection refused>)" on all three queries. No domestic supply record was seen, but absence of a retrievable record is not proof of absence — hence unknown, not none_found.
note: Exporter identity is consistent across both ImportKey slugs: RUBBER KING TYRE PRIVATE LIMITED / RUBBER KING TYRES INDIA PVT. LTD., 103-104 Naindhara Apartment, S.G. Highway, Bodakdev, Ahmedabad-380054, Gujarat; shipment origin port Thar Dry Port ICD Ahmedabad (INSAU6). Declared HS 401120 (new pneumatic tyres for buses/lorries) is only partly matched: actual observed codes are 40118000 (tyres for construction/industrial handling), 40129020/40129049 (solid tyres, flaps) and 40139090 (inner tubes) — the company ships a mixed tyre/tube/flap basket, so the declared code should be corrected to the observed range rather than the company rejected (per rule 3). Destinations confirmed by dated B/L-numbered records: Turkey (Aliaga/Istanbul), UAE (Jebel Ali), Honduras (Puerto Cortes). Revenue and export volume in value terms: null — not public in the free views; the 3126-shipment counter is a record count, not a value, and was not extrapolated. Domestic side: no evidence found either way, so domestic_status is unknown rather than a claim of no supplies. Trader/manufacturer role not assessed here (out of scope for this role); note only that the company both exports under its own 'Rubber King'/'Gemini' brands and appears as a buyer from Chinese machinery suppliers (Qingdao KSL) and UAE trader Neimon General Trading LLC.
